Log(TPM+1) normalized counts

counts.norm.tuto.Rd

Normalized gene expression matrix from bulk RNAseq.

Usage

counts.norm.tuto

Format

Matrix with genes as rows and samples as columns

Examples

data(counts.norm.tuto)
head(counts.norm.tuto)
